events.verdict: O'Neale (UTA) makes marginal contact with Neto (UTA) during his drive.
Neto (WAS) is the last person to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. The possession is correctly awarded to UTA.
Gobert (UTA) establishes himself in a screening position in Avdija's (WAS) path and does not deliver contact.

Replay review of the foul called on Neto (WAS)  pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Neto (WAS) moves laterally in O'Neale's (UTA) path during his drive to the basket, and the contact affects his SQBR.
Avdija (WAS) establishes himself in a screening position in O'Neale's (UTA) path and does not deliver contact.
As Neto (WAS) establishes himself in Ingles' (UTA) path on the screen, Ingles lowers his shoulder and delivers contact that dislodges Neto from his legal position.
Avdija (WAS) extends his hand into Mitchell's (UTA) back, affecting his body's trajectory on his driving shot attempt.
O'Neale (UTA) dislodges the ball from Beal (WAS) before incidental contact occurs.
Neto (WAS) establishes himself in a screening position in O'Neale's (UTA) path and gives him a step to avoid contact.
O'Neale (UTA) moves alongside Beal's (WAS) path during his drive to the basket, and marginal contact occurs.
Gafford (WAS) and Gobert (UTA) engage and disengage with one another during rebounding.
Avdija (WAS) places and retracts his hand from O'Neale's (UTA) body after his gather, and the contact is marginal.
Avdija (WAS) places his forearm on Gobert's (UTA) body, causing marginal contact to occur on Gobert's put-back shot attempt.
Mitchell (UTA) makes marginal contact with Neto's (WAS) side during his drive.
Mitchell (UTA) places his hand on the ball and makes clean contact to force a jump ball.
Avdija (WAS) legally contest Mitchell's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Gay (UTA) and Neto (WAS) engage and disengage with one another during rebounding.
Bogdanovic (UTA) commits a take foul on Beal (WAS).
Gobert (UTA) establishes himself in a screening position in Avdija's (WAS) path and makes marginal contact as they disengage.
